title: Tell Me the Old, Old Story
description: Tell Me the Old, Old Story in Tonic Solfa to EVANGEL (DOANE): the solfa with the words, staff notation, the four verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Katherine Hankey wrote the poem The Old, Old Story in 1866; these words are taken from it. The tune, EVANGEL (DOANE), is by William H. Doane (1870).
underlay: Tell me the old, old sto-ry, Of un-seen things a_-bove Of Je-sus and_ his_ glo_-ry, Of Je-sus_ and his_ love. Tell_ me the sto-ry sim-ply_, As to_ a_ lit-tle child, For I am weak_ and_ wea_-ry, And help-less_ and de_-filed. Tell me the old, old sto-ry, Tell me the old, old sto-ry Tell me the old, old sto-ry, Of Je-sus and_ his love.

lines: Tell me the old, old story,
For I am weak and weary,

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story
Tell me the old, old story,
That I may take it in—
Tell me the same old story,
When you have cause to fear
Yes, and when that world’s glory
Tell me the old, old story:
